property_summary: For any provided two distinct addresses A and B placed into the clone's immutable calldata at offsets 0x10 and 0x28, the reference C.debt() always returns the address encoded at offset 0x28, while the mutant (reading offset 0x10) will return the address at 0x10 and thus differ when those two addresses are not equal.
change_summary: Return the address from a different immutable offset (0x10 instead of 0x28) causing debt() to resolve to a different ERC20 address.
